runs.content: Broadridge Financial Solutions (BR) picked up at the previous close ($183.08) — wide-moat proxy/governance infrastructure at a ~28% discount to Morningstar's $255 fair value, fresh Q4 FY2026 beat-and-raise (Aug 4) plus a new 12% dividend increase and $1.5B buyback, chosen over Zoetis (a Burry long, but just cut FY26 guidance) and Hershey (already re-rated above fair value). CrowdStrike's own Thursday earnings beat lifted CRWD +20.5% in one session to +37.44% overall, now within ~9% of T2. JBHT was exited discretionarily (−11.73%, −$117) to keep the book at 35 open positions after BR's entry — no mechanical stop-losses or signal exits on the other 33 continuing positions. Portfolio net P&L: +$2,721 (+5.34% on $51,000).

Evertec (EVTC) picked up at the previous close ($29.76) — a LatAm payments/fintech name at ~13.8x P/E near its May 2026 low after a Q1 EPS miss and June data-breach disclosure, but with the Dimensa acquisition now closed, 2026 EPS guidance raised (~9.9%), ~$210M TTM FCF, and analyst targets of $32.60-35.80, chosen away from today's narrow Nvidia/Salesforce/CrowdStrike-driven tech rally to avoid Burry's semiconductor/AI-capex conflict zone. This run follows a 17-day scheduling gap (last run 2026-08-10) — only today was processed, no back-dated trades. MRNA hit T2 (+150.49% @ $149.66) on Moderna's Merck-partnered melanoma vaccine Phase 3 win (announced during the gap) — mechanical tranche sale (~$835), final 1/3 now runs uncapped as the portfolio's largest open gainer. No stop-losses or signal exits. Portfolio net P&L: +$2,745 (+5.49% on $50,000).
